name: markitdown
description_en: Python tool for converting files and office documents to Markdown.
readme_excerpt: MarkItDown > [!IMPORTANT] > MarkItDown performs I/O with the privileges of the current process. Like open() or requests.get(), it will access resources that the process itself can access. Sanitize your inputs in untrusted environments, and call the narrowest convert function needed for your use case (e.g., convertstream(), or convertlocal()).
